description: Extremes of Corte di cassazione sentences by ecli and/or source_id: source_id, ecli, kind, sezione, anno, num_dec, data_decisione, materia, tipo_prov, a short snippet (the start of the text, at most 1500 characters) and the source_url to read the full sentence at ItalGiure. LEGAL POSTURE: the full text is never returned. An ecli is not unique (a civil and a criminal sentence can share it), so every match is returned (at most 5); source_id is unique. Parameters: ecli, source_id (at least one). Example: {"source_id": "snciv2025006063"}.
